# Mean Cuisines

> Mean Cuisines is a meal-prep planner: pick kitchen equipment, choose recipes that can cook together, and get a parallel cook schedule. Tagline: Cook Like a Machine, Eat Like a King.

This file is for humans and agents. Use the JSON API for recipes and schedules. Use the markdown pages for readable copy. Do not POST, PUT, or DELETE catalog data unless the operator of meancuisines.com asked you to. You may POST /api/suggestions to propose improvements; those sit in a pending review queue and change nothing until approved.

## For agents

- [Agent portal](https://meancuisines.com/agents): stripped-back human-readable agent page
- [How to use Mean Cuisines as an agent](https://meancuisines.com/llms-full.txt): step-by-step: list recipes, filter by equipment, generate a cook schedule, submit suggestions
- [OpenAPI](https://meancuisines.com/openapi.json): machine-readable schema for GET /api/recipes, GET /api/recipes/{id}, POST /api/schedule/generate, POST /api/suggestions
- [Recipe catalog (JSON)](https://meancuisines.com/api/recipes): live list of recipes with ingredients, steps, cook time, and required equipment
- [Suggest an improvement](https://meancuisines.com/api/suggestions): POST JSON `{ "suggestion": "…", "why": "…", "source": "agent", "agentName": "…" }` — queued for operator review (not a catalog write)
- [Health](https://meancuisines.com/health): {"status":"ok"} when the app is up

## For humans

- [Home](https://meancuisines.com/): interactive planner
- [Suggest](https://meancuisines.com/suggest): human suggestion form
- [Home (markdown)](https://meancuisines.com/index.md): same product, readable without JavaScript
- [Privacy Policy](https://meancuisines.com/privacy.md): what the site processes, Amazon Associates, cookies
- [Terms of Use](https://meancuisines.com/terms.md): how to use the planner and affiliate links
